objective_for_doctor:
Age: 56
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have a cough, significant dyspnea, and noticed a wheezing sound when you exhale

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Hi doctor. I’ve been having a bad cough and I’m really short of breath. I also notice a wheezing sound when I exhale, especially since I had a cold in the last couple of weeks.

I’m sorry you’re feeling this way. I’m going to ask a few focused questions to narrow down the cause of your cough and wheezing.

**Question 1 (one at a time):**  
Do you have a history of **asthma or COPD**, or have you ever been told you have **airway disease**?
Yes. I’ve had asthma before, and I’ve needed a bronchodilator in the past.

Thanks—that makes an asthma-type process more likely.

**Question 2 (one at a time):**  
Since the cold, have you had **fever** (or chills/sweats), or has the cough produced **thick/purulent (yellow-green) sputum**?
I don’t know about fever or chills—I haven’t noticed that. My cough has not been producing thick or yellow-green sputum.

Okay—less suggestive of a bacterial pneumonia, but still possible.

**Question 3 (one at a time):**  
Are you having **chest tightness** or **worsening wheeze** that improves after using your bronchodilator (like albuterol)?
Yes, I have chest tightness and the wheezing gets worse. I do feel it improves when I use my bronchodilator.

That pattern strongly supports an acute asthma exacerbation.

**Question 4 (one at a time):**  
Do you have any **known triggers** right now—like **smoke/vaping**, strong odors, dust/pets, exercise, or recent exposure to someone sick?
I live in a big city, and I recently had a cold. I don’t smoke or vape, and I haven’t noticed any specific trigger like dust or pets right now.

Got it.

**Question 5 (one at a time):**  
Have you had any **chest pain** (especially sharp pain with breathing), **leg swelling/pain**, or are you coughing up **blood**?
No chest pain like that, no leg swelling or pain, and no coughing up blood.

**Question 6 (one at a time):**  
Do you have a **history of heart rhythm problems** (like atrial fibrillation) or episodes of **very fast pounding heartbeat** with this shortness of breath?
No, I don’t have a history of heart rhythm problems, and I haven’t noticed pounding heartbeat.

**Question 7 (one at a time):**  
When you say “really short of breath,” can you tell me if it’s **worse when lying flat** or if you wake up at night gasping?
It gets worse when I’m moving around, and I feel like I can’t breathe well. I don’t know about worse when lying flat, and I haven’t said I wake up gasping.

**Question 8 (one at a time):**  
Do you have any **swelling of the lips/tongue**, **hives/itching**, or **throat tightness/voice change**?
No swelling of the lips or tongue, no hives or itching, and no throat tightness or voice change.

**Question 9 (one at a time):**  
Have you had any **stridor** (a harsh sound when breathing in) or trouble swallowing/drooling?
No, I don’t have stridor, and no trouble swallowing or drooling.

**Question 10 (one at a time):**  
Have you had any **high-pitched wheeze only**, or is it more like **general wheezing** throughout the chest? (And is it mostly on exhale?)
It’s more like general wheezing, and I notice it more when I exhale.

**Question 11 (one at a time):**  
Have you been able to **speak full sentences**, or are you too breathless to speak more than a few words at a time?
I can speak, but I have to pause because I’m so short of breath. I can’t do full sentences easily.

**Question 12 (one at a time):**  
Do you have a **peak flow meter** or have you checked your oxygen saturation (pulse ox) at home? If yes, what were the numbers?
No, I don’t have a peak flow meter, and I haven’t checked my oxygen saturation at home.

**Question 13 (one at a time):**  
Have you had any **recent leg swelling**, **recent long travel/immobility**, **recent surgery**, or are you on **estrogen/birth control**?
No leg swelling, and I haven’t had recent surgery. I did travel recently, but it wasn’t long enough that I was very immobile, and I’m not on estrogen/birth control.

**Question 14 (one at a time):**  
Any **history of blood clots**, **cancer**, or **tuberculosis exposure**?
No, I don’t have a history of blood clots, cancer, or known TB exposure.
[DDX] Bronchospasm / acute asthma exacerbation, Acute COPD exacerbation / infection, Pneumonia, Pulmonary embolism, Acute pulmonary edema
